backhand.definition:
n. a return made with the back of the hand facing the direction of the stroke
v. hit a tennis ball backhand
a. (of racket strokes) made across the body with back of hand facing direction of stroke
backhand.translation:
n. 手背拍, 反手抽击, 左斜手写体
v. 反手抽击

backhandedness.definition:
n. State of being backhanded; the using of backhanded
   or indirect methods.

backhander.translation: n. 逆打,追加的一杯酒,<英>回扣

backhanders.translation: n. 反手一击( backhander的复数形式 ); 贿赂

backhanding.definition:
-ing form of backhand
n. a return made with the back of the hand facing the direction of the stroke
v. hit a tennis ball backhand
a. (of racket strokes) made across the body with back of hand facing direction of stroke
backhanding.translation:
(backhand 的现在分词) n. 手背拍, 反手抽击, 左斜手写体
v. 反手抽击

backhands.definition:
n a return made with the back of the hand facing the direction of the stroke
v hit a tennis ball backhand
backhands.translation: n. 反手, 反手击球( backhand的名词复数 )

backhaul.translation: n. (货运车的)回程(通常亦载货),回程运费

backhauling.translation: n. (为了避免空车返回而)回程载货，归途运货，回程运输的货物

backhoe.definition: n. an excavator whose shovel bucket is attached to a hinged boom and is drawn backward to move earth
backhoe.translation: n. (有伸缩挖掘装置的)锄耕机

backhouse.definition:
n. A building behind the main building. Specifically: A
   privy; a necessary.
backhouse.translation: n. 后面的小屋, (尤指)厕所

backhouses.definition:
plural of backhouse
n. A building behind the main building. Specifically: A
   privy; a necessary.
backhouses.translation: (backhouse 的复数) n.后面的小屋, (尤指)厕所
